text:
Maya: Deploy-bot is holding promotion for v3.4.2-canary. CI verify failed: artifact checksum mismatch between registry and the build cache. Need quick decision: pin to v3.4.1 or force a cache-busted rebuild?

Deploy-bot: promotion-check failed for image redwood/api@sha256:feedface
expected: sha256:feedface
observed-on-host-cache: sha256:deadbeef
action: promotion blocked

Arun: That observed checksum is from our shared build cache mirror (runner-cache-02). Could be a stale cache entry from last week's failed upload.

Priya: If we force rebuild, it will take ~25m and could still hit the mirror if the cache hasn't been purged. We don't want to extend the change window unnecessarily.

Ethan: What about pinning to last good canary v3.4.1 (sha256:c0ffee)? We can manually promote and record a hotfix rebuild to run off-hours with explicit cache-bust.

Maya: I prefer pin+rebuild later. We have customers in the EU needing the change window. Also need to update release notes to say "promotion deferred due to artifact checksum drift; pinned to last good canary".

Sam: I can run the manual promote. Deploy-bot supports: /deploy promote --image sha256:c0ffee --env canary --meta "pin-checksum-drift"
I will also add a rollback playbook link in the notes.

Release-bot: auto-generated checklist: remember to add a blurb to release-notes/drafts/3.4.x and include the rollback steps and the rebuild PR link.

Arun: I'll open an incident in registry-monitoring and add a retention/purge job for runner-cache-02. If this was a transient upload, we should purge the cache entry and re-sync.

Priya: I'll create the rebuild PR with explicit cache bust flag and CI job that uploads with --no-chunked to avoid multipart truncation:
```
ci/pipeline.yml:
  steps:
    - name: build-image
      run: ./tools/build-image --tag v3.4.2-canary --cache-bust --upload-flags="--no-chunked"
```

Deploy-bot: Manual promote command received from Sam. Status: queued -> promoting -> smoke-run. Will post outcome.

Maya: Action items: Sam promote + watch metrics 10m, Arun file registry incident + purge cache entry, Priya open rebuild PR + mark for overnight run, Ethan update release-notes draft and link PR, Maya will notify product about delayed features. Reconvene if smoke fails.

Deploy-bot: promote completed -> smoke-run passed. Canary promoted to v3.4.1 (sha256:c0ffee).

Maya: Great. Closing loop: release-notes updated with note about checksum drift and follow-up rebuild scheduled for 04:00 UTC. We'll mark the change window as used. Thanks all. :tada:
